review_candidates.title: Senior Python Software Engineer – Azure, Distributed Systems & AI (NYC)
review_candidates.description: Location: NYC, NY Work Policy: Hybrid — 2 days per week in-office Level: Senior Experience: 8+ years of professional software engineering experience About the Role "Please apply only if you can attend in-person interview at NYC location and can do hybrid. This isn't a remote only position" We are looking for a hands-on Senior Python Software Engineer with deep core Python expertise and a proven track record of building, deploying, debugging, and operating production software on Microsoft Azure. This role is for an engineer who understands what it takes to ship reliable software beyond the development environment. You have built real applications and backend services, diagnosed complex production issues, improved performance under load, and taken ownership of systems throughout their lifecycle. We are not looking for data scientists, research-focused AI practitioners, or engineers whose primary experience is building ETL jobs, data ingestion frameworks, or data pipelines. We need a strong software engineer first—someone who writes maintainable Python, understands concurrency and distributed systems, and can independently troubleshoot issues in live environments. Experience building AI-powered applications and integrating LLMs into production software is a plus, but strong software engineering fundamentals and production ownership are essential. What You'll Do Core Python Engineering Design, develop, test, and maintain production-grade Python applications and backend services. Write clean, modular, maintainable, and efficient Python code using appropriate design patterns and engineering best practices. Work with asynchronous programming, concurrency, multithreading or multiprocessing, and efficient resource management where appropriate. Diagnose complex application issues, investigate memory and performance bottlenecks, and improve application reliability. Build robust error handling, retry mechanisms, timeout management, and recovery strategies for failure-prone systems. Production Deployment & Operational Ownership Own software from development through deployment, production monitoring, troubleshooting, and ongoing maintenance. Investigate and resolve production incidents involving application failures, latency, resource exhaustion, dependency failures, and unexpected behavior. Use logs, metrics, distributed tracing, profilers, and debugging tools to identify root causes and implement lasting fixes. Design and implement effective unit, integration, and regression testing strategies. Participate in on-call support, incident reviews, root-cause analysis, and preventive engineering improvements. Azure Cloud Engineering Deploy, operate, and maintain Python applications and services hosted on Microsoft Azure. Work with Azure Functions, App Service, Azure Container Apps, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), or other relevant Azure hosting services. Understand cloud application lifecycle management, scaling, configuration, identity, networking, secrets, and dependency management. Troubleshoot production issues involving cold starts, resource limits, service availability, timeouts, throttling, and distributed failures. Implement reliable CI/CD workflows, deployment validation, monitoring, and rollback strategies. Backend & Distributed Systems Design reliable APIs and backend services that integrate with databases, external services, and cloud-native components. Apply practical knowledge of HTTP, REST APIs, authentication, caching, connection pooling, and service-to-service communication. Build resilient applications using queues, asynchronous processing, event-driven communication, and distributed systems patterns where required. Understand consistency, idempotency, retries, race conditions, concurrency limits, and failure isolation. Collaborate with engineers across application, platform, infrastructure, and AI teams to deliver production-ready solutions. AI Application Engineering — Preferred Integrate LLMs and AI capabilities into production applications using APIs and frameworks such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, LangChain, or Semantic Kernel. Build application-level AI features, including tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and workflow orchestration. Address practical production concerns such as latency, reliability, token usage, cost control, evaluation, and graceful failure. Apply conventional software engineering practices to AI applications, including testing, observability, security, and release management. Required Qualifications 8+ years of professional software engineering experience , primarily in backend development, application engineering, or distributed systems. Strong hands-on Python expertise , including application design, debugging, testing, performance optimization, and writing production-quality code. Demonstrated experience shipping and maintaining software that runs in production—not just prototypes, notebooks, scripts, or proof-of-concept applications. Real-world Microsoft Azure experience , including deploying and troubleshooting applications hosted in Azure production environments. Strong understanding of backend application architecture, APIs, databases, networking fundamentals, and distributed systems. Experience diagnosing production incidents, identifying root causes, implementing fixes, and preventing recurrence. Practical experience with automated testing, source control, CI/CD, monitoring, and safe software deployment practices. Ability to independently own technical problems, make sound engineering decisions, and communicate clearly during incident investigation and resolution. Preferred Qualifications Experience operating Python applications on Azure Functions, App Service, Azure Container Apps, or AKS. Experience with FastAPI, Flask, Django, or similar Python application frameworks. Strong understanding of asyncio, asynchronous I/O, concurrency control, and performance profiling. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, infrastructure configuration, and automated deployment workflows. Experience with relational or NoSQL databases, caching, messaging systems, and external service integrations. Experience shipping AI-enabled applications using LLM APIs, Azure OpenAI, RAG, or agent orchestration frameworks. Familiarity with Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, OpenTelemetry, or comparable observability tools. Working knowledge of C# or .NET is helpful but not required. What This Role Is Not This position is primarily a software engineering role, not a data engineering or research role. Not a data scientist or machine learning research position. Not primarily an ETL, data ingestion, or data pipeline development role. Not a role focused exclusively on notebooks, model experimentation, or AI proofs of concept. Not a position where cloud experience is limited to certifications, tutorials, or personal lab projects. We value engineers who can explain how their software behaves in production, how they investigate failures, and how they make systems more reliable over time. Interview & Work Logistics Location: NYC, NY. Work Arrangement: Hybrid, with 2 days per week in the office. Interview Process: Candidates must be available for initial in-person interviews at our designated office location in the NYC. Engineering Depth & Experience Verification We value demonstrated engineering ability over keyword-heavy résumés. Candidates should be prepared to discuss real examples of Python applications they have shipped, their role in deploying and operating those applications, and challenging production issues they personally investigated. We will assess practical Python proficiency, debugging methodology, system design, Azure production experience, testing practices, and operational judgment. We are looking for engineers who can take ownership, work through ambiguity, and deliver software that remains reliable after it reaches production

review_candidates.title: Senior Backend Engineer, Shopping Agents
review_candidates.description: Sage AI Labs Munich Full-time [Remote] About Us Sage AI Labs is building the infrastructure that lets AI agents transact on the open web. It is one of the few genuinely unsolved problems left in commerce, and whoever solves it sets the defaults everyone else builds on top of. The company was founded by Sebastian Thrun (founder of Google X and Waymo, Udacity) and is backed by leading venture and strategic investors. About The Role We build agents that shop for you. They find products across the open web and complete the purchase end to end. Real carts, real payments, and real systems built to stop them. You would own that. Architecture, code, deploys, monitoring, and on-call for systems that transact around the clock, working directly with our CTO. What you'll own Our checkout agents. Frontier-model computer-use agents driving live checkouts at scale, plus the machinery that keeps them standing when the ground moves. Every retailer breaks differently and they change without warning. Your job is to make failure rare and recovery automatic. Ingestion at scale. Take product ingestion from hundreds of sources to thousands. The answer is not more hand-written code. It is infrastructure that generates, validates, and monitors itself. Search and ranking. Embedding-based retrieval, LLM query understanding, reranking, and caching, across a catalog that never stops changing. What we're looking for 5+ years building backend and infrastructure systems, with strong Python You have owned production systems end to end: deploys, databases, observability, and the pager. You have been the person who got paged, and you fixed the class of problem rather than the incident You like adversarial problems. Systems where something on the other side is actively working against you You take correctness seriously because the stakes are real. These systems spend customers' money, so a silent failure is a wrong order, not a red build You can move without a finished spec. We are small, and the roadmap changes when the market does Nice to have Built AI-first products or LLM-based agents in production, not just in a prototype Working knowledge of classic ML and deep learning, enough to reason about retrieval and ranking rather than only calling an API Background in e-commerce, payments, or fraud and risk infrastructure Why this role Very few engineers get to own a category-defining system while the category is still being defined. This is one of those seats, at the point where it still counts as early. A year from now this problem will have a standard answer and someone will have written it. We intend for that to be us.
